'''Meilarra''' was the sister of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Nehanna]] of [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. When Nehanna disappeared, Meilarra sought to become [[Regent/Legends|regent]] until Nehanna's son, [[Ebrahi]], came of age. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] supported her bid to gain the position.<ref name="Strongholds" />
